name: Bluemount Holdings Limited Class B Ordinary Shares
description: Bluemount Holdings Ltd through its operating subsidiaries, it is a Hong Kong-based consulting and advisory and financial services provider, as well as trader of commodities such as luxury timepieces. The financial services includes underwriting and placing services, securities dealing and brokerage services, and asset management services. It provides comprehensive consulting and advisory services on business development strategies to its diverse clientele. Generally, the company provides consulting and advisory business for the following segments: Corporate Finance; and Strategic Communications.
